rule.description: A method on a repository-defined named type whose body is dominated by member reads and calls rooted at a different repository-defined named type passed as a parameter (>= 4 member-access events, strictly more than its own receiver and every other repo-typed root). Driven as a golang.org/x/tools go/analysis unitchecker binary invoked by go vet over the repository's production packages in GOPATH mode.

checks.description: Report methods whose member-access events are dominated by a repository-defined parameter root: at least 4 events through that parameter, strictly more than through the receiver and every other repo-typed root, with method invocations through the root counting double.
checks.detected_relation: method(receiver: repo-named type) -> dominantly accesses data of (parameter: another repo-named type)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The method's interest lies in another owner's data, not its own state: the relation is the Go form of a helper parked on the wrong owner, and moving the logic onto the data-owning type is what restores data locality.

matches.evidence: fillFromError on the JSON payload struct reads its inputs from the passed twirp.Error parameter (Msg, Code, MetaMap - one read plus two getter invocations) and writes its own three fields; measured foreign 6 vs own 3; reported at errors.go:409.

protoNameOf on the registry reads file package, lineage, and descriptor data from the passed MessageDefinition (File, Lineage invocation, Descriptor invocation) and never touches registry state; measured foreign 4 vs own 0; reported at typemap.go:97.

descendantsOf on the registry builds child MessageDefinitions recursively from the passed definition's NestedType, path, File and descriptor data, recursing through the registry only via re-dispatch of itself; measured foreign 4 vs own 2; reported at typemap.go:116.

methodDeps on the generator struct only pairs the registry's MethodInputDefinition/MethodOutputDefinition lookups (two invocations each) and reads nothing from its own receiver; measured foreign 4 vs own 0; reported at generator.go:282.

goTypeNameFromDef on the generator struct derives the Go name from the passed MessageDefinition (File lookup, Lineage invocation, Descriptor invocation) with receiver touches confined to package naming; measured foreign 4 vs own 3; reported at generator.go:1589.

excluded.reason: Generated test-fixture services (16 packages) and twirptest/testdata are the repo's own generated fixtures, not maintained production logic; the rule scope is the 15 production packages.

Vendored third-party packages (protobuf, pkg/errors, storm,AWS SDK pieces) are excluded by construction: only types defined under the repository import path and outside vendor are credited as roots or owners, so a repair has a home inside this repository.

The relation is defined on methods with a named receiver; free functions taking repo-typed arguments (e.g. messageDefsForFile, New, marshalErrorToJSON) are not swept - envy attributed without a wrong owner is not the assigned relation.
